sloka: रामस्य गदितं श्रुत्वा हरयो रामसन्निधौ ।चोदयन्ति हनूमन्तं सीतावृत्तान्तकोविदम् ।। ५.६५.६ ।।।।
transliteration: rāmasya gaditaṁ śrutvā harayo rāmasannidhau ।codayanti hanūmantaṁ sītāvṛttāntakovidam ।। 5.65.6 ।।।।

translations.english: On hearing the words from Rama, the vanaras requested Hanuman who was aware of Sita's position to tell Rama all about her.
